files.note: wide diagnostic sheet (auxiliary): one fixed camera per facing row, 4 columns incl. the last active tick (late frames included); same overlays and measurement path as the primary sheet

primary contact sheet; overlays: red = runtime hitbox, green = hurt capsules, orange = projectile, yellow cross = nearest point of the piece's XY-projected surface + line to the hitbox centre (signed_separation = that distance minus the radius), magenta = tip, white = joint, cyan = piece bounds; measured on the drawn pose after a history reset + replay
